permissions.title: Permissions & privacy
permissions.intro: Mulinda asks for a few permissions to make tracking effortless. Each is optional - you can turn them on now or later from Profile.
permissions.smsBody: When enabled, Mulinda reads incoming mobile-money and bank SMS (Airtel Money, TNM Mpamba, banks) and drafts a transaction for you to review. We only look at messages that contain a financial transaction - personal messages are never read or stored. You can turn this off any time.
permissions.cameraBody: Used only when you snap a receipt to extract the transaction.
permissions.photosBody: Lets you pick a receipt image from your gallery to scan.
permissions.notifBody: Bill and loan reminders, end-of-day nudges, and subscription updates.
permissions.footer: You stay in control. Permissions can be changed any time in Profile, or in your phone settings. We never sell your data.
